extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, awards followers, and the general public interested in Peabody Awards
extracted.subtask_description: A press release describing the Peabody Awards' special honors (Career Achievement, Trailblazer, Institutional), the Board of Jurors, and the values and categories the Awards recognize. It outlines what the Awards honor and examples of past and current honorees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Achievement Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Career Achievement Award recognizes an individual whose exceptional body of work and creative contributions have made a significant impact on media and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Previous recipients include Andrea Mitchell, Mel Brooks, and Sam Pollard. The announcement highlights Amy Poehler's multifaceted career (actor, writer, director, producer, podcaster, founder of Paper Kite Productions) and her broad cultural impact as examples of the kind of career honored.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trailblazer Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Trailblazer Award recognizes visionaries whose innovative storytelling styles impact culture and effect social change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Previous recipients include Ahmir 'Questlove' Thompson, Quinta Brunson, and inaugural winner Issa Rae. The press release cites Sterlin Harjo's work (e.g., Reservation Dogs, The Lowdown) as exemplar — work that is deeply personal, culturally groundbreaking, and brings overdue stories and voices to audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Institutional Award recognizes institutions and organizations, as well as series and programs, for their enduring body of work and their lasting impact on the media landscape and the public imagination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Previous recipients include 'Saturday Night Live,' 'Fresh Air with Terry Gross' and '60 Minutes.' The release frames PBS KIDS—with decades of educational programming, games, and community initiatives serving children ages two to eight—as an example of the institutional mission and sustained impact this award honors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core selection values — 'Stories That Matter'
rubrics_metrics.description: Peabody Awards honor 'stories that matter' — works that defend public interest, encourage empathy and expand our understanding of the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winners are described as stories that powerfully reflect pressing social issues and vibrant emerging voices of our day, and that can have positive effects on society. The release emphasizes the Awards' role in shining a light on storytelling that advances truth, social justice, and equity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Categories and eligible media formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Peabody Awards are given in categories including entertainment, documentary, news, podcast/radio, arts, children’s and youth, and public service programming; they recognize television/broadcasting as well as digital and podcast programming and (since 2021) interactive and immersive media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The release lists exemplar winners across categories (e.g., Hill Street Blues, The Wire, Bluey, Cosmos) and notes Peabody's expansion to include interactive and immersive media and honors for podcasts/radio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection process and Board of Jurors composition
rubrics_metrics.description: The Peabody Board of Jurors, comprised of media industry professionals, journalists, critics and scholars appointed to six-year terms, selects nominees and winners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All programs that are nominated and win Peabody Awards must receive a unanimous vote by the Board of Jurors. The release also notes recent appointments and leadership (new jurors, Interactive Board member, and Board Chair) as part of the governance of selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reputation standards — integrity and excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: Peabody Awards are 'respected for [their] integrity and revered for [their] standards of excellence.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The release positions the Peabody as a distinctive honor that prioritizes high standards and integrity in recognizing work across major productions to local journalism; this underpins the Awards' credibility and selection ethos.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on lasting impact and diversity of scale
rubrics_metrics.description: The Awards recognize work that has a lasting impact on the media landscape and public imagination, from major productions to local journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The release cites examples spanning blockbuster series and local/specialty programs to show that both large-scale and community-focused work can meet Peabody standards if they reflect pressing issues, emerging voices, or educational/social value.
